analysis-policy.reason: Retain Brikk inference-policy overloads, ordered recursive set reconciliation, identity caches and published uncache API instead of a wholesale upstream cache/qualification refactor.

sort-compatibility.reason: Keep both published SortArray and ArraySort classes, constructors and serde identities. No implicit breaking node migration.

duckdb-native-policy.reason: Reuse the separately qualified DuckDB 2.0 native models and DDB20-055 refusal matrix. Do not import generic rewrites over session-sensitive/native execution contracts.

query-plan-optimizer.reason: Query-plan rewrites, decorrelation, join elimination and constant folding are explicitly outside this parser/transpiler/analysis catch-up. No optimizer behavior is claimed ported.
query-plan-optimizer.owner: Jayson Minard, separately approved optimizer work

unsupported-profiles.reason: The changed Oracle/Athena/Teradata/Databricks/Fabric/SQLite/Snowflake/TSQL profile is not a supported Brikk dialect. Shared generated node definitions may be refreshed without adding that dialect or claiming execution.

python-runtime-and-diff.reason: Python packaging, compiled bindings, workflows and the Python AST edit-script diff implementation have no corresponding JVM runtime subsystem in this catch-up.

integration-test-revisions.reason: These commits only advance upstream's external integration-test submodule. The frozen local fixtures are refreshed in SG29-020; unrun external engine suites remain explicitly unclaimed.

release-changelogs.reason: Release-note-only upstream commits do not require a Brikk behavioral port or change Brikk publication versions.

shared-escaping.reason: Shared property keys, single-string intervals and Presto WEEK rewrites interpolate raw text. Review and cover quoting before coherent refresh; native acceptance is a separate claim.

nested-explode.reason: explodeProjectionToUnnest searches through nested queries. Restrict every explode/zip discovery to its own scope and retain outer-map/zip semantics during SG29-020.

copy-progress.reason: Initial COPY probes did not reproduce a hang. Kotlin parseVar(anyToken=true) consumes punctuation too. Pin finite malformed-input behavior and add a null/progress guard rather than claim a reproduced infinite loop.

bounded-integer-classification.reason: Expression.isInt uses toLongOrNull, not Python int(float(...)); large exponents do not materialize enormous integers or throw ValueError. Keep the bounded classification policy, not Python's floating-point definition of integer.

replace-tables-api.reason: No replace_tables-equivalent public helper exists. Structural Expression.transform/replace is not that name-based API; do not add a new API merely to port its upstream fix.

generated-case-sensitivity.reason: The AST generator already emits _hash_raw_args but the frozen tables predate the new per-node flags. Refresh generated flags and hand-owned case/serde controls coherently, preserving structural rather than hash-collision equality.

ref-type.reason: REF requires a token and DType plus parsing of a named table target, not just enum regeneration. Preserve REF function/identifier parsing and do not claim native-engine support from generic parsing.

review-91143554.reason: Unnamed MySQL constraints are a syntax feature; retain whole-command fallback for unsupported definitions instead of promising native DDL execution.

review-676ba365.reason: Named FOREIGN KEY index syntax needs a separate structured/native DDL contract, not a name-only parser alias.

review-c0a94574.reason: Tests follow the named FOREIGN KEY index feature; no independent runtime change.

review-b1b244b1.reason: SPLIT_TO_TABLE column qualification belongs to an unsupported Snowflake TVF; do not infer arbitrary unknown TVF columns.

review-fdba492c.reason: Alias collision in merge_subqueries is a query-plan transformation outside this catch-up.

review-d747f5b2.reason: Python's huge-int materialization is not Kotlin's bounded Long conversion. Pin large interval rendering and failure behavior during integration without introducing an arbitrary-precision simplifier.

review-ca870e84.reason: Unknown property classes currently emit a null name after warning; omit the unknown property instead, with an explicit diagnostic regression in SG29-020.

review-b50e43e4.reason: PASTE JOIN needs a new token and supported grammar. Keep native execution unqualified; target token tables alone must not imply a new join contract.

review-2444b6db.reason: The associated PASTE JOIN optimizer scope change does not independently qualify PASTE JOIN execution.

review-7af2aa8d.reason: Pivoted CTE alias registration must be compared with Brikk's existing PIVOT scope model, not replace it with the upstream scope refactor.

review-e3d0dfb2.reason: ORDER alias expansion must not share AST children. Compare the existing copy policy and target alias corpus before changing analysis order.

review-d44db25a.reason: PARTITION BY EXCLUDING is a new generic AST/syntax feature. Refresh its schema but do not claim native engine support from generic rendering.

review-5d588c0f.reason: Unsupported struct-star operands must remain unresolved, not fabricate complete schemas. Retain conservative Engine policy and review exact target fixture deltas.

review-67961afb.reason: JSON-path alias matching must preserve unknown paths and not choose a false alias. Compare existing structural equality and target corpus evidence.

review-e6c7d527.reason: INSERT target aliases must not consume the target column list. Inspect structured Schema ownership and add target regression during SG29-020.

review-9fedfa5f.reason: Comment propagation follows the INSERT alias/column-list parser fix; retain comments without mutating caller-owned nodes.

review-3377b957.reason: Parser cleanup is part of that same INSERT alias ownership fix, not a separate feature.

review-43fbff20.reason: Positional alias type inference is compared with Brikk's existing recursive set/CTE output reconciliation; keep duplicate names and explicit unknowns conservative.

review-7c4e124f.reason: Caching positional column alias mappings is not an API or correctness requirement. Keep existing identity-cache invalidation contracts.

review-069a7517.reason: ClickHouse NATURAL JOIN already has independent native parsing/typing safeguards; target generic output is not authority to weaken them.

review-76001235.reason: Snowflake splitter and BigQuery pivot changes include schema-less TVF inference. Keep the explicit Brikk inference-policy divergence and bounded pivot result contracts.

review-5f3b52da.reason: Cleanup to unknown-source qualification follows the same splitter/pivot work; do not back-project guessed schemas.

review-a9f1309c.reason: UNION BY NAME internal renaming is a query-plan canonicalization pass, not the native set-operation output reconciler.

review-c068aefd.reason: replaceLambda must give each synthesized Cast its own DataType child; add a parent-ownership regression before target refresh.

review-8c5600ad.reason: ClickHouse Contains under unary minus requires grouping. Review the generic parenthesization path and target fixture before claiming equivalence.

review-bffbfbe4.reason: This only refines the corresponding ClickHouse test; no independent production change.

review-33c72094.reason: SEMI/ANTI RHS tables must remain invisible to outer column resolution. Existing Engine/shape controls are retained; compare the new target scope fixture exactly.

review-a357b7d9.reason: PostgreSQL TABLESPACE is new DDL syntax. Metadata preservation is not an authorization to execute native CREATE statements.

review-9943dc46.reason: Resolver semi/anti unknown-source handling must preserve Brikk's explicit unknown-schema conservatism and inference overloads.

review-b0842a1e.reason: PER aggregate syntax is a new generic node, not a supported-engine execution contract; refresh metadata only unless independently qualified.

review-04f4a440.reason: IN as a contextual identifier needs grammar controls so the operator keeps its meaning. Review target cases during SG29-020.

review-06aa274a.reason: Warning expectations are test harness data and are incorporated through the coherent corpus extraction, not a global warning suppression.

review-90759771.reason: Unsupported-property warning expectations remain case-specific corpus data; retain diagnostics for unknown properties.

review-7e4d995f.reason: ClickHouse parenthesized CTAS with COMMENT must not gain another wrapper on each generation. Review idempotence without executing DDL.

semi-using-left-value.reason: Brikk's USING expansion records a nonempty left source and selects lhs directly for SEMI/ANTI joins. It never constructs upstream's empty COALESCE; retain the richer mergedValues model.

placeholder-replacement-api.reason: No replace_placeholders public helper exists. Keep parameter/source-map ownership in existing Brikk APIs rather than add a new name-based expression-builder API.

regex-count-qualification.reason: Do not equate Trino REGEXP_COUNT and ClickHouse countMatches from names alone. The separately queued bounded Trino work and unproved ClickHouse mapping remain separate.
